text: SaaS has siloed our data for decades. Now apps are easy to build, and agents need all our data. That demands a new security model.
Today agents get coarse access to everything, with no audit and no control. As they run continuously, across private and enterprise data, the risk keeps growing.
ECHO takes a different approach. It brings all your data into a single logical graph, so people and agents work from the same context.
That graph is partitioned into secure spaces, shared with the colleagues and agents who need them, even across organizations. Each agent sees only what its task requires.

And because it's open, it keeps growing. New sources, new apps and new agents plug into the same graph, and you never give up control. DXOS is the operating system for people and agents working together.
